description: Assess how far ABAP source is from ABAP Cloud (Clean Core tier 1) by parsing it twice — once at a classic baseline (default v758) and once at version Cloud — and diffing: findings that appear only at Cloud are genuine cloud blockers (statements ABAP Cloud removed), reported in categories (dynpro, list output, native SQL, report events, …) with a transparent score, an A–D tech-debt grade and a verdict; findings already present at the baseline are reported separately as broken code, not migration work. It also reports snapshot-dated released-API observations for direct table and function-module references the parser can extract; those stay separate from the language-level blocker count and score. Use this when someone asks 'is this code cloud-ready / Clean Core compliant / S/4HANA-cloud safe', before porting classic ABAP into an ABAP Cloud environment, or for a graded tech-debt assessment of an abapGit export. It is static and parser-level: its released-API scan is not exhaustive dependency discovery, it does not connect to any SAP system or run ATC, and a 'ready' verdict means no detected language-level blockers — not a certification. Our A–D grade is blocker density (see gradeMeaning), NOT SAP's own Clean Core Level A–D; a target system's own released-API ATC check ("Usage of Released APIs (Cloudification Repository)" for SAP Cloud ERP Public Edition / "Usage of APIs (Cloudification Repository)" for SAP Cloud ERP Private Edition / on-premise, via variants such as ABAP_CLEAN_CORE_DEVELOPMENT / ABAP_CLEAN_CORE_READINESS) remains authoritative. Example: check_cloud_readiness({ "files": [ { "source": "REPORT zold.\nWRITE: / 'hi'." } ] }).

baselineVersion.description: Classic ABAP version the code is assumed to run on today; used to separate broken-anyway code from cloud blockers.

edition.description: SAP edition of the bundled Cloudification snapshot to check against: "s4hc" (default, SAP Cloud ERP Public Edition), "btp" (SAP BTP ABAP environment), or "pce" (SAP Cloud ERP Private Edition / on-premise). Release state and successors can differ by edition — the same object may be released in one and not yet in another.

files.description: Source files to analyze, up to 32 per call, 100k chars each.

filename.description: abapGit-style name, e.g. "zcl_invoice.clas.abap", "ztrip.prog.abap", "zr_trip.ddls.asddls". Omit it and the type is inferred from the source (CLASS → class, REPORT → program, define view → CDS).

source.description: The complete ABAP / CDS / behavior-definition source text.

name: check_cloud_readiness

brokenAtBaseline.description: Findings that fail even at the baseline version — fix first, they are not migration items.

category.description: Stable category id, e.g. dynpro, list-output, native-sql.

findings.description: The individual findings (same shape as lint_abap).

label.description: What this category means and the usual remediation.

rewrite.description: Curated canonical Cloud rewrite for this category, when one is bundled.

after.description: ABAP Cloud skeleton it is usually rewritten to.

before.description: Classic ABAP skeleton the category typically looks like.

notes.description: Caveats — the recipe is illustrative, not drop-in.

pattern.description: Name of the canonical rewrite pattern.

cleanCoreVocabulary.description: SAP's real ATC vocabulary for released-API/Clean Core checks — see docs/atc-vocabulary.json (F04).

checks.description: The real ATC checks behind released-API governance (name, edition, note).

variants.description: The real ATC check variants, current and deprecated-with-successor.

cloudBlockerCount.description: Statements valid at the baseline but not in ABAP Cloud.

edition.description: SAP edition the released-API findings were checked against.

fileCount.description: Files analyzed — the denominator of the grade's density banding.

grade.description: Blocker-density tech-debt grade (see gradeMeaning): A = no blockers, B = ≤ 0.5 blockers/file, C = ≤ 2 blockers/file, D = more. The same objective count as the score, sized for assessment reports.

gradeMeaning.description: What `grade` means: a banding of blockers per file. NOT SAP's own Clean Core Level A–D (see cleanCoreVocabulary.cleanCoreLevels for those) — do not conflate the two.

releasedApiFindings.description: Released-API observations from the bundled SAP Cloudification snapshot (deprecated-API usage, direct non-released table access with successor hints, and which edition/source answered each one). Informational — NOT counted in cloudBlockerCount or score.

releasedApiSnapshotDate.description: Date of the bundled released-API snapshot the releasedApiFindings reflect.

scopeNote.description: Exactly what this check does and does not cover.

score.description: 100 − 5×blockers, floored at 0. Transparent, not an oracle.

verdict.description: Banded verdict from the blocker count (0 / ≤5 / ≤20 / >20).

title: Check ABAP Cloud readiness
